stem_md: 设 $z=y^x$，则 $\left.\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)\right|_{(2,1)}=(\quad)$。
analysis_md: $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y^x\ln y,\quad\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=xy^{x-1}$，从而 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=y^x\ln y+xy^{x-1}$，将 $(x,y)=(2,1)$ 代入得 $\left.\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right)\right|_{(2,1)}=2$
